about: What a person checks for each partly automatic BITV / EN 301 549 step of web UI v2. python -m tests.a11y.manual_review --prepare turns the steps the report still marks 'manual review pending' into a worksheet (a11y-manual-review.json): one check per question, page and session. Edit this file to change a question; the worksheet and the docs are generated from it.
setup: Run ekte serve and open http://127.0.0.1:8000/. Run one audit so that History, Analytics and a report exist, and add one monitor. Use the UI language and theme the session names unless a check names another.

desktop-browser.label: Desktop browser, keyboard and mouse, no screen reader
desktop-browser.browser: Chrome or another Chromium browser (for the DevTools rendering emulations)

touch.label: Phone or tablet with a touch screen

9.1.1.1.why: A machine finds missing text alternatives, not whether an alternative is meaningful.

checks.do: Move through the graphics and the icon-only buttons and listen to each name.
checks.expect: Each name says what the image or icon means or does; purely decorative images are not announced.

9.1.3.1.why: A machine cannot tell whether headings, lists and tables match the visual meaning.

checks.do: Open the list of headings, then the list of landmarks.
checks.expect: The heading outline matches the visible sections in order and level; main, navigation, banner (header) and content info (footer) are listed.

tools: NVDA: T (next table), Ctrl+Alt+arrow keys (move by cell)
checks.do: Move into each data table (the audit report, the Analytics tables, the test steps) and step through its cells.
checks.expect: Moving to a cell announces its row and column header together with the data.

checks.do: Move through the fields and filters that are visually grouped (radio buttons, filter panels, advanced options).
checks.expect: Entering a group announces the group name; each field is announced with its own label.

9.1.3.2.why: The tests compare the reading order with the visual order; whether the order makes sense is a judgement.

tools: NVDA: Down arrow in browse mode, or Insert+Down arrow (say all)
checks.do: Read the page from top to bottom, then open each disclosure, tab and "Show more" and read on.
checks.expect: The order makes sense, and content revealed by a disclosure, tab or "Show more" is read right after its control.

checks.width: 320 CSS px (browser window narrowed, or 400 % zoom)
tools: NVDA: Down arrow in browse mode
checks.do: At 320 CSS px width, read the page from top to bottom.
checks.expect: The order still makes sense where the layout stacks columns.

9.1.3.3.why: A heuristic finds wording that may rely on shape, position or colour; a person judges the hits and the rest.

checks.do: Read every instruction, hint and help text.
checks.expect: No instruction relies only on shape, size, position, colour or sound (such as "the green button" or "on the right").

9.1.4.1.why: The tests check links and the known status displays; whether colour alone carries meaning elsewhere is a judgement.

tools: Chromium DevTools: Rendering, Emulate vision deficiencies: Achromatopsia
checks.do: Emulate greyscale and look at every status, badge, trend, chart series and highlighted item.
checks.expect: Each state is still told apart by text, icon, pattern or position.

9.1.4.11.why: Form controls and focus indicators are measured; charts and icons are not.

tools: DevTools colour picker or the Colour Contrast Analyser
checks.do: Measure each chart series, bar, meter, marker and informative icon against its neighbours and the background.
checks.expect: Each reaches 3:1, or the same information is in adjacent text or a data table.

tools: DevTools colour picker or the Colour Contrast Analyser
checks.do: In the dark theme, measure each chart series, bar, meter, marker and informative icon against its neighbours and the background.
checks.expect: Each reaches 3:1, or the same information is in adjacent text or a data table.

9.1.4.13.why: The tests hover and focus every element; whether revealed content is additional content is a judgement.

checks.do: Show every tooltip, popup and menu with the mouse and with Tab.
checks.expect: Escape closes it without moving focus; the pointer can move onto it without it closing; it stays until dismissed or no longer relevant.

checks.do: At 200 % zoom, show every tooltip, popup and menu again.
checks.expect: It is fully visible, does not hide the control that opened it, and behaves as at 100 %.

9.2.2.2.why: The tests find motion and auto-updates at rest; whether an update is essential is a judgement.

checks.do: Start an audit, and let a monitor run.
checks.expect: Nothing moves, blinks or updates for more than five seconds unless it is essential or there is a control to pause, stop or hide it.

tools: OS setting: Windows Settings, Accessibility, Visual effects, Animation effects off; macOS Reduce motion
checks.do: Turn on reduce motion in the operating system and reload the page.
checks.expect: Animations (charts, counters, transitions) do not run.

9.2.4.3.why: The tests check that nothing hidden takes focus; whether the order is logical is a judgement.

checks.do: Without the mouse, press Tab through the page, then through each opened disclosure and tab panel.
checks.expect: The focus follows the reading order with no unexpected jump, and returns to the control that opened a disclosure when it closes.

checks.do: Open the key-storage (master key) dialog, press Tab through it and close it.
checks.expect: The focus moves into the dialog when it opens, stays in it while it is open, and returns to the control that opened it.

9.2.4.4.why: Every link has a name; whether the name describes the target is a judgement.

checks.do: Open the list of links.
checks.expect: Each link name, alone or with its sentence, list item or table cell, says where the link goes.

9.2.4.6.why: Headings and labels exist and are not empty; whether they are descriptive is a judgement.

tools: NVDA: Insert+F7 (elements list: headings, form fields)
checks.do: Open the list of headings, then the list of form fields.
checks.expect: Each heading says what its section is about, and each label says what the field is for.

9.2.5.1.why: No gesture handlers are found; only a person confirms that every function works with single taps.

checks.do: Operate every control with single taps only: charts, tables, tabs, sort, filters and disclosures.
checks.expect: No function needs a swipe, pinch, drag or multi-finger gesture.

9.3.2.2.why: The tests change every control and watch for a change of context; whether a change was announced beforehand is a judgement.

checks.do: Change the language and the theme with the keyboard (the switches in the header, the same on every page).
checks.expect: The control says what it changes before it is used; afterwards the focus stays on it and no window opens.

checks.do: Change every select, checkbox, switch and field of the page (filters, sort, page size, options) with the keyboard.
checks.expect: Each change is described before it is made, and none moves the focus, opens a window or replaces the content unexpectedly.

9.3.3.1.why: The tests check that errors are marked and linked; whether a message is clear is a judgement.

checks.do: Submit an empty audit form, then an invalid key, then an endpoint that cannot be reached.
checks.expect: Each error is announced when it appears, names the field, says in plain words what is wrong, and the focus or the error link leads to the field.

checks.do: In German, submit an empty audit form and an invalid key.
checks.expect: The errors are announced in German, name the field and say what is wrong.

checks.do: In Chinese, submit an empty audit form and an invalid key.
checks.expect: The errors are announced in Chinese, name the field and say what is wrong.

checks.do: Save the page's form empty or with an invalid value (a monitor; a knowledge-base entry).
checks.expect: Each error is announced when it appears, names the field, says in plain words what is wrong, and leads to the field.

9.3.3.2.why: Every field has a label; whether the instructions are sufficient is a judgement.

checks.do: Fill in each form and filter of the page using only the labels and hints shown.
checks.expect: The required fields, the expected format and the effect of each option are clear before submitting.

9.3.3.3.why: Error messages exist and are translated; whether they suggest a fix is a judgement.

checks.do: Cause each error of the page's form (empty field, invalid value).
checks.expect: Where a fix is known, the message says how to correct the input.

9.4.1.3.why: Status areas are live regions; whether each change is actually announced is only heard.

checks.do: Cause each status change of the page without moving the focus: audit progress, finish and failure; Copy link, sort, filter and "Show more"; saving and running a monitor; saving a knowledge-base entry.
checks.expect: Each result or progress change is spoken, once, without the focus moving.
